name: svg-french-press-perceptron-mk1.5-s1-r8
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 1200" width="600" height="1200">
  <style>
    .component { fill: none; stroke: #333; stroke-width: 2; }
    .glass { fill: rgba(200, 220, 255, 0.3); stroke: #4a90d9; stroke-width: 2; }
    .metal { fill: #e0e0e0; stroke: #666; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .wood { fill: #8b5a2b; stroke: #5a3a1b; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .mesh { fill: url(#meshPattern); stroke: #333; stroke-width: 1; }
    .label { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #333; }
    .leader-line { stroke: #999; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; }
  </style>

  <defs>
    <pattern id="meshPattern" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="6" height="6">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="6" y2="6" stroke="#333" stroke-width="0.5"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="6" x2="6" y2="0" stroke="#333" stroke-width="0.5"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="300" y="70" text-anchor="middle" class="label" font-size="24" font-weight="bold">French Press Exploded View</text>

  <!-- Component 1: Lid with Handle (top) -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 160)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="70" ry="15" class="metal"/>
    <rect x="-10" y="-40" width="20" height="40" class="wood"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="-40" rx="15" ry="10" class="wood"/>
    <text x="0" y="-55" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Lid with Handle</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Component 2: Glass Carafe -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 340)">
    <rect x="-60" y="-80" width="120" height="160" rx="5" ry="5" class="glass"/>
    <rect x="-60" y="-80" width="120" height="160" rx="5" ry="5" class="component"/>
    <text x="0" y="-90" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Glass Carafe</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Component 3: Plunger Rod -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 500)">
    <rect x="-5" y="-60" width="10" height="120" class="metal"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="-60" rx="20" ry="15" class="wood"/>
    <text x="0" y="-75" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Plunger Rod</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Component 4: Filter Frame -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 660)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="55" class="metal"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="45" class="mesh"/>
    <text x="0" y="-65" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Filter Frame</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Component 5: Base Plate -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 820)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="50" class="metal"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="30" class="glass"/>
    <text x="0" y="-60" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Base Plate</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Assembly arrows -->
  <path d="M 300 180 L 300 220" class="leader-line" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>
  <path d="M 300 360 L 300 400" class="leader-line" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>
  <path d="M 300 520 L 300 560" class="leader-line" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>
  <path d="M 300 680 L 300 720" class="leader-line" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>

  <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
    <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#999"/>
  </marker>
</svg>
